examples.japanese: {王妃|おうひ}が{懐妊|かいにん}された。
{懐妊|かいにん}の{知|し}らせを{受|う}けて、{家族|かぞく}は{大|おお}いに{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: Upon receiving the news of the pregnancy, the family was overjoyed.

examples.japanese: {宮内庁|くないちょう}は{皇室|こうしつ}の{懐妊|かいにん}を{正式|せいしき}に{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The Imperial Household Agency officially announced the imperial pregnancy.

notes:
A formal, respectful term for pregnancy. Composed of {懐|かい} (bosom, to carry) + {妊|にん} (pregnancy). Primarily used in formal announcements, historical texts, and when speaking about royalty or the imperial family. Not used in everyday medical or casual contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懐妊|かいにん}の{報|ほう}: news of pregnancy
- {懐妊|かいにん}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: to announce a pregnancy
- ご{懐妊|かいにん}: pregnancy (honorific)

USAGE:
Most commonly seen in news about the Japanese imperial family or in historical/literary contexts. The respectful prefix ご is almost always attached when referring to royalty: ご{懐妊|かいにん}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {妊娠|にんしん}: pregnancy — the standard, everyday medical term
- {身|み}ごもる: to conceive, to become pregnant — a native Japanese word, somewhat literary
- おめでた: pregnancy — informal, euphemistic, used when congratulating
